    Resume Tailor

    • Computer Science

    A command-line tool that turns a job posting link into a one-page, ATS-safe résumé built only from verified facts.

    • A validator in code (src/validate.py) blocks any added or enlarged employer, title, date, number, skill or scope.
    • A judge-and-revise loop aims for a 9/10 résumé-quality score and reports job match and keyword coverage separately. 352 pytest tests run offline.

    • Pydantic

    Insider Tracker

    • Finance
    • Computer Science

    A self-hosted web app that tracks SEC Form 4 insider-trading filings from official EDGAR data.

    • A scheduled worker pulls Form 4 filings from EDGAR into Supabase Postgres. The Next.js dashboard only reads that database, so it never hits EDGAR rate limits.
    • Bring your own database: the repo ships with no keys and no data.
    • TypeScript
    • Next.js
    • Supabase (Postgres)
